evals.prompt: Convert an editor-only Apps Script web app into a Git/clasp project with test and production projects, npm tests, and safe release steps.
evals.expected_output: A source layout, secret-safe clasp configuration, manifest review, target checks, test project flow, CI gates, versioned deployment, smoke tests, and rollback.

evals.prompt: Our developer ran clasp push but production still serves old code. Diagnose this without overwriting unknown remote changes.
evals.expected_output: A safe diagnosis distinguishing source push from versioned deployment, inspecting status/config/deployments, preserving local/remote work, and giving verified redeploy and rollback steps.
